title: MONTHLY ENTERPRISE CYBERSECURITY
THREAT INTELLIGENCE SUMMARY
report.sourceNote: Compiled automatically from CISA KEV, NVD, FIRST EPSS, Google Project Zero, ENISA EUVD, VulnCheck, Metasploit, Exploit-DB, PoC-in-GitHub and MITRE ATT&CK. Counts are catalog counts, not a count of cyber incidents; anything the sources do not establish is stated as not established.

blocks.text: CISA added **26 vulnerabilities** to the KEV catalog in July 2026, spanning 16 vendors. CISA flags known ransomware use for 4 of them. The highest-likelihood additions by EPSS were **CVE-2026-39808 (Fortinet FortiSandbox)** and **CVE-2026-48908 (JoomShaper SP Page Builder)**. Outside KEV, 1 further CVE was reported exploited or tracked as zero-days by Google Project Zero, ENISA EUVD or VulnCheck.

**Top five actions:** (1) Isolate or patch exposed Fortinet FortiSandbox (CVE-2026-39808); (2) isolate or patch exposed JoomShaper SP Page Builder (CVE-2026-48908); (3) isolate or patch exposed Microsoft SharePoint (CVE-2026-50522); (4) isolate or patch exposed Microsoft SharePoint Server (CVE-2026-45659); (5) examine Fortinet FortiSandbox hosts for unexpected child processes and outbound connections.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-39808 - Fortinet FortiSandbox OS command injection (CVSS 9.8).** A improper neutralization of special elements used in an os command ('os command injection') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiSandbox 4.4.0 through 4.4.8 may allow attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via Fixed package release: not mapped in NVD ranges; 1 vendor patch or advisory reference available. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

**CVE-2026-48908 - JoomShaper SP Page Builder unrestricted file upload (CVSS 10).** A vulnerability in SP Page Builder for Joomla allows unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary files, ultimately resulting in the upload and execution of PHP code. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): sp page builder 6.6.2. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

**CVE-2026-50522 - Microsoft SharePoint unsafe deserialization (CVSS 9.8).** Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): sharepoint server 16.0.19725.20434. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.
KEV additions by week: week of Jun 29: 1; week of Jul 6: 6; week of Jul 13: 10; week of Jul 20: 6; week of Jul 27: 3.

Known ransomware use (CISA): CVE-2026-45659 (Microsoft SharePoint Server), CVE-2026-15409 (SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances), CVE-2026-15410 (SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances) and CVE-2026-20316 (Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC)).
No campaign-specific IP addresses, hashes or domains are collected by ThreatWatch's automated feeds. Victim counts and campaign scope are not established unless cited in section 5.

**Defensive hunting focus:** unexpected child processes and outbound connections (8 CVEs); unexpected file writes and persistence (5 CVEs); unauthorized administrative access and configuration changes (5 CVEs).
